text_en: When you go out to war against your enemies, and see horses and chariots, an army larger than your own, you shall not be afraid of them; for the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
text_cn: 当你出征进攻你的仇敌，见到战马战车和比你更多的群众时，你不必害怕，因为领你出埃及地的上主你的天主与你在一起。

text_en: Before you engage in battle, the priest shall come forward and speak to the troops,
text_cn: 当你们快要交战时，司祭应上前来，对民众训话，

text_en: and shall say to them: “Hear, O Israel! Today you are drawing near to do battle against your enemies. Do not lose heart, or be afraid, or panic, or be in dread of them;
text_cn: 向他们说：“以色列，请听！你们今天就要上阵攻打你们的仇敌，你们不要灰心，不要害怕，不要恐慌，不要在他们面前战栗，

text_en: for it is the Lord your God who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to give you victory. ”
text_cn: 因为上主你们的天主与你们同去，帮助你们攻打你们的仇敌，使你们胜利。”

text_en: Then the officials shall address the troops, saying, “Has anyone built a new house but not dedicated it? He should go back to his house, or he might die in the battle and another dedicate it.
text_cn: 然后长官对民众说：“谁若盖了新房屋，还没有祝圣，他可回家去，免得他死在战场，别人来替他祝圣。

text_en: Has anyone planted a vineyard but not yet enjoyed its fruit? He should go back to his house, or he might die in the battle and another be first to enjoy its fruit.
text_cn: 谁若栽种了葡萄园，还没有享用过，他可回家去，免得他死在战场，别人来替他收获。

text_en: Has anyone become engaged to a woman but not yet married her? He should go back to his house, or he might die in the battle and another marry her. ”
text_cn: 谁若与女人订了婚，还没有迎娶，他可回家去，免得他死在战场，别人来娶她。”

text_en: The officials shall continue to address the troops, saying, “Is anyone afraid or disheartened? He should go back to his house, or he might cause the heart of his comrades to melt like his own. ”
text_cn: 长官再继续对民众致辞说：“谁若害怕灰心，他可回家去，免得他使兄弟的心，如他的一样沮丧。”

text_en: When the officials have finished addressing the troops, then the commanders shall take charge of them.
text_cn: 长官向民众训完话，就派定军官统率部队。

text_en: When you draw near to a town to fight against it, offer it terms of peace.
text_cn: 当你临近一城要进攻时，应先向那城提议和平；

text_en: If it accepts your terms of peace and surrenders to you, then all the people in it shall serve you at forced labor.
text_cn: 若那地给你和平的答复，给你开门，城内所有的人民就臣服于你，给你服役。

text_en: If it does not submit to you peacefully, but makes war against you, then you shall besiege it;
text_cn: 如不与你讲和，反愿与你作战，你就围攻。

text_en: and when the Lord your God gives it into your hand, you shall put all its males to the sword.
text_cn: 几时上主你的天主将城交在你手中，你应用利刃杀尽所有的男人；

text_en: You may, however, take as your booty the women, the children, livestock, and everything else in the town, all its spoil. You may enjoy the spoil of your enemies, which the Lord your God has given you.
text_cn: 至于妇女、婴儿、牲畜和在城内所有的一切，算是你夺得的胜利品，你可享用你由仇人夺得的胜利品，因为是上主你的天主赐给你的。

text_en: Thus you shall treat all the towns that are very far from you, which are not towns of the nations here.
text_cn: 这是你对于离你很远，且不属于这些民族的城市的作法。

text_en: But as for the towns of these peoples that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, you must not let anything that breathes remain alive.
text_cn: 但是在上主你的天主赐给你作产业的这些人民的城市内，你不可让任何生灵生活，

text_en: You shall annihilate them—the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites and the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites—just as the Lord your God has commanded,
text_cn: 应将他们：即赫特人、阿摩黎人、客纳罕人、培黎齐人、希威人和耶步斯人，尽行毁灭，如上主你的天主吩咐你的，

text_en: so that they may not teach you to do all the abhorrent things that they do for their gods, and you thus sin against the Lord your God.
text_cn: 免得他们教你学习他们对自己的神所行的一切可恶之事，使你们得罪上主你们的天主。

text_en: If you besiege a town for a long time, making war against it in order to take it, you must not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them. Although you may take food from them, you must not cut them down. Are trees in the field human beings that they should come under siege from you?
text_cn: 若你围攻一座城，需要多日才能攻取占领，你不可用斧头砍伐那里的树木；你可以吃树上的果子，却不可砍倒树；难道田间的树可当作你围攻的敌人看待？

text_en: You may destroy only the trees that you know do not produce food; you may cut them down for use in building siegeworks against the town that makes war with you, until it falls.
text_cn: 只是那些你知道不结实的树木，你可毁坏砍伐，用来建筑围攻的设备，为进攻与你交战的城市，直到将城攻下。
